issues.quote: R&D expense climbed to $4.5 billion from $3.1 billion
issues.problem: Tesla's fiscal 2023 R&D was about $3.97 billion, not $3.1 billion ($3.07 billion was the fiscal 2022 figure). The real increase was about 14%, not about 45%.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit and margin, operating income and margin, net income and EPS are all correct. The prior-year R&D figure is wrong: fiscal 2023 R&D was about $4.0 billion, not $3.1 billion.
